meaning: 在学业上取得很大进步
usageNote: 动词短语，夸孩子学习进步时超好用！语气积极正面，老师家长的口头禅～

examples.en: She worked really hard and managed to make big improvements in her schoolwork this semester.
examples.zh: 她这学期非常努力，成功在学业上取得了很大进步。

examples.en: The teacher was proud to see all her students make big improvements in their schoolwork after the extra tutoring.
examples.zh: 看到所有学生在补课后学业大幅进步，老师感到非常自豪。
